summary: Adult male tent camper injured when a bear trampled his tent at a dispersed campsite off CR 67J; transported to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries; CPW investigation closed inconclusive, no bear located
location: Dispersed camping area off County Road 67J (Prairie Divide Road), Red Feather Lakes area
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Larimer County Sheriff's Office
notes: Family of four tent-camping on USFS property; attack likely food-attractant related; ~11 p.m. Tuesday (run 954)
